cody.line: And can't you see her up there, Cody?
stanza: And I will follow you to Virgie
'Cause that's what us boys are for
To help you out when you get weary
And you can't go no more
And can't you see her up there, Cody?
I can see her through the pines
Please turn the pages for me
I am humiliated by my weakness and my impotence
I'll prove to you that I can change
With one brave historic act, I will win your love, now and for all eternity
